generated.what_happened: An independent commission has found Manchester City guilty of the majority of 115 Premier League financial charges covering a nine-season period between 2009 and 2018, as well as failing to cooperate with the league's investigation. The inquiry concluded that the club utilized sham commercial contracts and disguised funding schemes to artificially inflate revenues by hundreds of millions of pounds while concealing its true financial condition. Manchester City maintained its innocence, expressing disappointment with the ruling and stating its intent to pursue an appeal. Potential sanctions remain undecided and will be determined at a separate hearing, with possible penalties ranging from fines and point deductions to expulsion from the league.
